summary.tldr: Implements tax, housing, health and employment measures from the 2021 economic and fiscal update.
what_it_does: Creates a refundable tax credit for eligible businesses that pay for ventilation upgrades to improve air quality.
Expands the northern residents deduction so all northern residents can claim up to $1,200 in eligible travel expenses, even without employer travel assistance.
Raises the School Supplies Tax Credit from 15% to 25% and lets eligible educators claim electronic devices.
Creates a refundable tax credit for farming businesses in backstop jurisdictions to return fuel charge proceeds.
Enacts a 1% annual tax on vacant or underused residential property owned by non-resident non-Canadians, with reporting and enforcement rules.

Sets a six-year limit to recover Canada Emergency Business Account loans, authorizes payments for school ventilation, COVID-19 vaccination proof and COVID-19 tests, and sets maximum Employment Insurance weeks for certain seasonal workers.
summary.background: The bill implements certain provisions of the economic and fiscal update tabled on December 14, 2021, and includes other measures.
